text:
samir: FYI escalation from cust452 — their embeddings suddenly went from 1536 -> 1024 after we pinned their model to a locked variant. They get an "embedding dimension mismatch" from our API.
anya: ack. do we have the request_id and exact variant they pinned to?
samir: request_id: req_0a9f3c4b, customer called out model: open-embed-xlarge@2026-03-10-lock. Happened ~2026-03-11T15:12:03Z. Error in their logs: 'Expected embedding vector length 1536, got 1024'.
anya: can you paste the failing client call (redact keys)? also did they pin via console or API?
samir: console pin via org admin. Here's their payload (redacted):
```json
{"model": "open-embed-xlarge@2026-03-10-lock", "input": "...", "user_id": "cust452-ops"}
```
ingrid: quick check — our model catalog shows two artifacts for open-embed-xlarge on that date: a quantized 1024 variant (artifact q1024) and a full 1536 float32 (artifact f1536). Looks like the lock may have bound them to a variant alias that now resolves to q1024.
matt: thanks. any rollout or substitution that could've swapped alias->artifact? deploy-bot, did a change occur around that time?
deploy-bot: [deployment-log] alias alias-open-embed-xlarge@2026-03-10 was updated -> artifact q1024 at 2026-03-11T14:58:12Z by infra-canary (automated fallback).
anya: that explains the size change. cust pinned the alias expecting f1536 but alias resolved to the quantized artifact during a canary fallback.
samir: customer needs a fast workaround — their index expects 1536. Can we force their pinned alias back to f1536 or provide a compatibility layer?
ingrid: short-term: we can repoint alias for that customer (namespace alias) back to f1536 and roll a hotfix to prevent alias fallback for pinned orgs. I'll open an infra PR.
matt: also add a guard in the serving layer to detect mismatched embed length on inbound requests and return clearer error with recovery hints (eg: include 'current_artifact' in error).
anya: I'm messaging cust452 with ETA: will revert alias for them in next 20m and follow up with a permanent fix. Also asking if they can re-run their index ingestion after revert. :thumbsup:
samir: noted. copying support ticket -> TKT-9876 with the remediation steps and escalated to eng-runtime.
anya: once alias is reverted, ask customer to validate a single sample call and confirm dims. keep me posted.
samir: will do. thanks everyone. :pray:
